chapter: Routine bands and the lake dances
title: Charlie Moore on banjo and playing with Jack Carey
summary: Williams says banjoist Charlie Moore played with him a long time before dying recently, and Moore also played with Jack Carey, with whom Williams played clarinet.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: You say you had your own band after you worked with it. Yeah. Did you have an old fellow named Sam Chase?
No, I didn't know Sam Chase.
I think he was a banjo player.
I didn't know him. Charlie Moore, he played banjo with me a long time. He died about two months ago.
I know. I never could find his address. I should have seen him.
Yeah, he lived on Luzon Avenue.
He played with a lot of people too. They didn't talk about it.
Yeah, he used to play with Jack Kerri. I played clarinet with Jack Kerri several times. Oh. Uh-huh.
